kebab_example: aliyun mpserverless update-service-policy --space-id 0e16bb12-14af-0000-b24c-5ac1a9a7bb9f --service-name db --policy .write_:false,_.read_:true --collection-name test --policy-name EXTENDED --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServicePolicy

parameters.help_en:
Service Name. Valid values:
db
file
parameters.help_zh:
服务名称。可选值：
db
file
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: Permission rule. Required when PolicyName is EXTENDED
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en: Collection Name. Required when ServiceName is db
parameters.help_zh: 集合名称，当ServerName为db时该参数必填
parameters.name: collection_name

parameters.help_en:
Policy Name. Required when ServiceName is db. Valid values:
PUBLICREAD: All users can read; only the creator and administrator can write. Scenarios: user comments, public information, etc.
PRIVATE: Only the creator and administrator can read and write. Scenarios: Product information, etc.
ADMINWRITEONLY: All users can read; only administrators can write. Scenarios: Product information, etc.
ADMINREADWRITEONLY: Only administrators can read and write. Scenarios: Backend data streams, logs, etc.
EXTENDED: Custom security rule
parameters.help_zh:
策略名称，当ServerName为db时该参数必填。可选值：
PUBLICREAD: 所有用户可读，仅创建者及管理员可写。适用场景：如用户评论、公开信息等。
PRIVATE: 仅创建者及管理员可读写。适用场景：商品信息等。
ADMINWRITEONLY: 所有用户可读，仅管理员可写。适用场景：商品信息等。
ADMINREADWRITEONLY: 仅管理员可读写。适用场景：后台数据流水、日志等。
EXTENDED: 自定义安全规则
parameters.name: policy_name
